critical_caveat: There is NO usable official household consumption survey between 2011-12 and 2022-23. The NSS 2017-18 consumption expenditure survey was conducted but never officially released -- the government withdrew it citing 'data quality issues', a widely-reported and controversial decision. This means the 2011-12 to 2022-23 gap is not just a missing data point, it's an 11-year gap with no official alternative. Additionally, MoSPI itself has noted that HCES 2022-23 used a revised survey methodology (modified questionnaire design, different recall periods for different item categories) compared to earlier NSS rounds -- so the 2022-23 point is not strictly methodologically comparable to 2004-05/2009-10/2011-12, even though the same 'percentage difference from average' framing is applied consistently here. Treat the trend direction as informative but the exact magnitude of change across the 2011-12 to 2022-23 gap with more caution than the within-round comparisons (2004-05 vs 2009-10 vs 2011-12, all from consistent methodology).

tables_used.absolute_mpce: Statement 3.1 (page 15): State/UT-wise average MPCE (Rs.) by social group for each sector -- All-India row used here.
tables_used.historical_gap_series: Statement 3.11 (page 28): Inter-social-group differences in average MPCE: change over time, all-India -- percentage difference of each group's average MPCE from the all-social-groups average, for 2004-05, 2009-10, and 2011-12. Sourced in turn from NSS Report No. 544 for the 2004-05/2009-10 points.

2022_23.report: NSS Report No. 591: Survey on Household Consumption Expenditure: 2022-23
2022_23.publisher: National Sample Survey Office, Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation

tables_used.absolute_mpce_with_imputation: Table 3.21 (page 54): Average MPCE (Rs.) by social group in 2022-23, major states -- All-India row used here. 'With imputation' means the value of items received free through social welfare programs is included, which is the report's preferred headline figure.

absolute_mpce_rs.note: All-India average MPCE in rupees, current prices of each survey year (not inflation-adjusted between years).

pct_gap_from_average.note: Percentage difference of each group's average MPCE from the all-social-groups average MPCE, same year, same sector. Negative = below average. 2004-05 and 2009-10 figures are transcribed directly from the source's own Statement 3.11. The 2011-12 figures are also transcribed directly from Statement 3.11 (and were cross-checked by recomputing them from the absolute MPCE table above -- they match exactly). The 2022-23 figures are COMPUTED here using the identical formula ((group_mpce - all_mpce) / all_mpce * 100) for methodological consistency with the source's own approach -- not values stated in the 2022-23 report itself, which doesn't include this specific framing.
